integrity: The proof is self-contained from the period-doubling morphism: it proves an exact desubstitution bijection on qualifying conjugacy classes and eliminates all odd lengths at least five by a parity obstruction. A standalone verifier directly enumerates factors and conjugacy classes over a substantial finite range as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary Lie complexity of the binary period-doubling fixed point only. It does not compute extended or prefix Lie complexity and does not generalize automatically to other Toeplitz or generalized period-doubling words.
title: Exact Lie complexity of the period-doubling word
